title: Chapter 239: Overwhelming Power
content:
Chapter 239: Overwhelming Power

In the sky, only the one hundred five-star giant light griffins were left, firmly caught in the trapping nets sprayed by the Zerg Queen, and covered with scars.

They had been successfully controlled by the Zerg Queen using parasitic control parasites. In order to temporarily not expose the fact that these powerful giant light griffins were controlled by the Zerg, a group of Zerg dragons flew over, grabbed them, flew into the Zerg army square, and threw them to the ground. Together with the ten five-star human heavy knights, they were guarded by Zerg dogs.

Nearly 100,000 Zerg Hydralisks that were liberated returned to the Zerg army square, and the Zerg dragon group flew over the sky above the lingering alien human heavy cavalry, cooperating with the Zerg ground forces that were already advancing forward, and launched a final attack on the surviving alien human heavy cavalry.

Zerg dragons and Zerg Hydralisks had some casualties in the battle with the light griffins just now, but basically there were more injuries and few deaths, which had little impact on the overall combat power.

The five-star Zerg destroyers injured by the Light Griffin Knights of the Alien Tribe are recovering rapidly, gradually regaining their attack capabilities, and joining the attack.

It won't be long before a thousand five-star Zerg destroyers will return intact again.

The biological bombs of the Zerg flying dragons, combined with the armor-piercing spikes, armor-piercing spikes, corrosive flames and Zerg biological decomposition liquids of the Zerg ground forces, quickly wiped out all the remaining heavy cavalry units of the Alien Tribe.

The heavy cavalry units in the Alien Tribe army, this core pillar force, disappeared in an organized manner.

The heavy cavalry units of the Alien Tribe, which used to be able to cause a shocking disaster if they didn't go out, did not cause any damage to the Zerg army. Under a series of attacks by the Zerg army, they all became system resources in a frustrated manner.

Only ten five-star knights were left, and they were controlled by the Zerg Queen. They were no longer believers of the Lord of Light, and they were no different from death.

The alien infantry phalanx not far away had its strength reduced from more than 500,000 to less than 100,000 under the attack of the Zerg destroyers.

These less than 100,000 survivors had completely lost their combat capability. They were dizzy with the super-long-range firepower of the Zerg led by the five-star Zerg destroyers. It would not be long before they would disappear in the light.

The surviving soldiers of the alien infantry phalanx were scattered in an area that originally occupied a large area. The sparse distribution of the enemies greatly reduced the killing efficiency of the Zerg destroyers.

Wu Qing ordered the Zerg destroyers to shift their attack targets and attack the infantry phalanx of the second alien army that followed closely, leaving the survivors of the first infantry phalanx that had lost their combat effectiveness to the Zerg ground forces.

The Zerg ground forces advanced quickly, and the armor-piercing spikes of the Zerg Hydralisk finally hit the melee infantry of the aliens.

The remnant alien melee infantry, including the mages and priests, had no power to fight back and were all easily killed by the dense armor-piercing spikes and biological bombs falling from the sky.

The second infantry phalanx of the alien army followed closely, with only about 300,000 troops. When 50,000 liquid fireball shells mixed with five-star, four-star, and three-star Zerg destroyers fell, their formation was disrupted.

The shells fired by the five-star Zerg destroyers cleared a large area, and no one was spared.

The shells fired by the four-star Zerg destroyers were enough to kill most of the enemies within the attack range and severely damage the remaining half.

The shells fired by the three-star Zerg destroyers can kill a few enemies within the attack range and injure a large area.

The shells fired by the remaining two-star Zerg destroyers can kill a small number of enemies with weakened defenses within the attack range, and consume and damage the remaining enemies.

The attacks of the four star strengths are mixed together in an orderly manner. After the calculation and adjustment of the Queen, the maximum killing efficiency can be achieved.

When the second round of attacks by the Zerg destroyers landed, the second infantry phalanx of the alien army that was attacked instantly lost more than half of its troops, and suffered devastating casualties!

They endured another round of fire from the Zerg destroyers, and were basically destroyed. The Zerg destroyers' firepower no longer targeted them, who were already very sparsely spaced, and turned to the main formation of the alien army further behind.

The three rounds of full-scale attacks by the Zerg destroyers directly destroyed the dense phalanx of about 300,000 alien infantry, leaving only tens of thousands of troops lingering on. It can be seen that with the participation of the five-star Zerg destroyers, their attack power has changed terribly.

The Zerg destroyers followed the advancing Zerg army, and rounds of artillery fire extended to the main formation of the alien army. The further back they went, the more five-star Zerg destroyers that recovered their attack capabilities.

Wu Qing felt that such firepower intensity was still a little insufficient compared to the alien army, which still had nearly four million troops.

If the battle goes on like this, the alien army will become more dispersed, and the killing effect of the Zerg Destroyer will be greatly reduced.

Wu Qing looked at the amount of system resources, and then looked at the nearly four million powerful alien army in front of him. He once again selected one thousand Zerg Destroyers, nine hundred Zerg Dragons, and the remaining eighty Zerg Exploding Mosquitoes, and upgraded them all to five-star levels!

Such an upgrade consumed all the system resources in an instant!

Two thousand Zerg Destroyers, one thousand Zerg Mutalisks, one hundred Zerg Queens, one hundred Zerg Hydralisks and eighty Zerg Blasting Swarms, this is the number of five-star troops in the Zerg army now!

After the Zerg army won this battle, the strength of this Zerg army fighting outside has made a qualitative leap!

The price is to consume all the accumulation of several huge gains and the gains of this war.

But as long as this battle is won, the gains will also be huge.

The Zerg puppies and stealth spiders lurking underground all crawled out and followed the Zerg army's ground forces to steadily advance forward.

Zerg Hydralisks, Zerg Roaches and Zerg Stealth Spiders cooperated with Zerg Mutalisks to eliminate the remaining forces of the infantry phalanx of the alien human army that was crippled by the Zerg Destroyers, which seemed very easy.

"The Zerg army is upgrading again!"

"This battle is almost an upgrade show for all arms of the Zerg army!"

"With this number of upgrades, they must all be five-star upgrades! With so many five-star arms in the Zerg army, the alien army is in trouble now!"

"The Zerg army doesn't seem to want to let the alien army leave!"

"The alien army is not simple, I wonder what other cards they have!"

"The alien army's cards have been targeted one by one by the Zerg army! Even if there are still cards, the Zerg should not be afraid!"

"Such a fierce method, don't fight to the end, and draw out the strong men of both sides!"

"What are you afraid of! If you can kill them, you have to kill them all! They are only allowed to hit us, but we can't hit them!"

"I'm really looking forward to it! I hope to wipe out this alien army!"

"..."

Now everyone is very familiar with the upgrade status of each arm of the Zerg army. As long as the Zerg pupates, it means that it is going to upgrade.

Everyone was looking forward to the next performance of the Zerg army.

"Boom boom...!"

The attack of the Zerg destroyers has extended to the main camp of the alien army.

With the firepower of nearly 2,000 five-star Zerg destroyers, after a round of artillery fire, tens of thousands of soldiers in the dense formation of the alien army disappeared, and the number of injured was countless!

Wu Qing saw the high-efficiency killing effect of the Zerg destroyers through the Zerg host, and immediately ordered the Zerg destroyers to attack the area where the enemy's troops were densely concentrated.

If the alien army needs to break through, it must gather superior forces to charge in formation, otherwise the scattered forces will not be able to break through the encirclement formed by the battle-hardened armies of various races in the local camp.

Those assembled alien armies have become the best attack targets for the Zerg destroyers at this time!

"Boom boom...!"

"Boom boom...!"

"..."

After several rounds of attacks by the Zerg destroyers, the alien army shrank its front line and assembled to break out, suffering a terrible blow!

The alien army lost nearly one million soldiers in these rounds of attacks!

If the fight continues like this, the alien army will be wiped out in less than three million soldiers in a short time!

"The new army is too fierce!"

"Everyone continue to strengthen defense! We must not let these evil god believers escape from us!"

"There is hope to annihilate the enemy! Send all the reserve forces to me!"

"The enemy is likely to break out from us! This opportunity is too rare! Even if we are wiped out, we can't let any of the enemy escape!"

"..."

The local camp army surrounding the alien army is a group of warlike and fearless strong races. Seeing that the alien army was beaten so badly by the Zerg destroyers, their morale was directly full and their fighting spirit was boiling!

The local army, which was still on the sidelines, quickly organized a defense line at the outermost edge of the battlefield.

Those who could go to this battlefield were not simple characters. They knew very well that if they did not go to the battlefield at this time, they would be absolutely useless in the eyes of the major clans, and they would never have a chance to stand out in the future.

The excellent performance of the Zerg army in this battle created this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, and it was time to test the armies of other races in the local camp.

In the alien human army, the human knight wearing gorgeous armor, facing such a corrupt battle situation, once again personally issued an order.

"Break through the east, south, and north at the same time!"

"Action now!"

The order to break through on three sides was issued immediately. The human knight wearing gorgeous armor, riding a tall and majestic warhorse, led the guardian knights around him and some mages and priests riding warhorses, and walked towards the breakout troops in the east.
